Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

This existing independently source-qualified family now has separate actual author, source-verifier and adversarial reviews of complete pinned creator-card text and exact substantive provenance, workflow, schema, access/rights declarations and limitations. The inspected README revision is documentation identity, not a verified download/recount or immutable inventory of the dataset payload. Configurations, stages, models and regenerated traces do not add families. No paper/code/media/payload, experimental performance, upstream-rights clearance or operational execution audit is represented. Original unsuccessful hypotheses and real negative reviews remain candidates.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Bespoke-Stratos · access terms: The Stratos-17k card declares Apache-2.0 for its dataset release.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.bespoke.declared-license-upstream-limit.v1

  • The corpus combines named upstream question sources and DeepSeek-R1 generations; the card label is not an independent rights audit of all input data, teacher outputs or code tests.
  • Curator and SkyThought links do not establish licenses for every linked artifact without reading their actual terms.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.bespoke.generation-time-and-cost-report.v1

  • This is a creator description of dataset generation, not a reproduced universal price or the total cost of model fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • The recipe and training/evaluation implementations are linked separately and were not read or executed in this card-only scope.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Bespoke-Stratos · has stage: Bespoke describes rejection sampling of incorrect solutions, Ray-cluster acceleration of code verification, and GPT-4o-mini math filtering in place of Sky-T1 parsing logic.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.bespoke.math-and-code-filtering.v1

  • Direct code-execution-verifier integration into Curator is described as work in progress at this card version.
  • The reported increase from 25% to 73% in retained correct math solutions is a creator-reported filtering result, not an independently checked error-rate or adjudication study.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Bespoke-Stratos · documents: The Bespoke card reports AIME2024 values of 63.3 for Stratos-32B and 20.0 for Stratos-7B, identified as fine-tunes of the corresponding Qwen2.5-Instruct models.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.bespoke.model-results-and-baseline-columns.v1

  • Tables distinguish creator-measured DeepSeek-distill baselines from reported values: 66.7 versus 72.6 for 32B and 43.3 versus 55.5 for 7B; those columns are not interchangeable.
  • These creator-reported model results are not an independent dataset-quality score, replicated improvement or significance result; linked evaluation code remains unread.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Bespoke-Stratos · documents: Bespoke attributes Stratos-17k to a Sky-T1-style pipeline ported into Curator using DeepSeek-R1, with roughly 5k coding items from APPs/TACO, 10k math items from NuminaMATH subsets and 1k science/puzzle items from STILL-2.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.bespoke.synthetic-lineage-and-composition.v1

  • DeepSeek-R1 replaces QwQ, and its traces are not passed through Sky-T1's GPT-4o-mini reformatting step.
  • The 17k name and rounded component counts do not establish an exact payload census; the card says rejection sampling can change the exact problems included.
  • Creator/pipeline and teacher-model roles do not establish a paid human annotation workforce or universal human verification.
